title: SwiftUI
description: SwiftUI reference covering view identity, state, bindings, observation, layout, navigation, lists, tasks, animation, accessibility, UIKit interoperability, testing, performance, and production architecture.

subtopics.title: Views, Identity & body
subtopics.description: A View value describes UI; SwiftUI reconciles descriptions using structural or explicit identity. body must remain cheap and free of imperative side effects.

callouts.title: Do Not Use Random Identity
callouts.text: Changing .id or unstable list IDs destroys state, focus, animations, and reuse. Identity must represent the same logical element across updates.

subtopics.title: State, Binding & Observation
subtopics.description: Choose a wrapper by ownership and sharing. Keep one source of truth and derive display values rather than synchronizing duplicates.

table.title: SwiftUI State Selection
rows: Ephemeral UI state or owned observable model

codeBlocks.code:
@Observable final class Model { var query = ""; private(set) var results: [Item] = [] }
struct SearchView: View { @State private var model = Model(); var body: some View { TextField("Search", text: $model.query) } }

subtopics.title: Stacks, Frames & Custom Layout
subtopics.description: Parents propose sizes, children choose sizes, and parents place them. Use stacks/grids first; apply frame and layoutPriority to express constraints, not fixed-screen assumptions.

subtopics.title: Lists, NavigationStack & Destinations
subtopics.description: Lists require stable identity. Model navigation as data with NavigationStack paths and typed destinations for testable deep links and restoration.

callouts.title: Do Not Use Array Indices as Persistent IDs
callouts.text: Insertions and sorting reassign indices to different items, producing incorrect row state and animations.

subtopics.title: task, Refresh & Lifecycle
subtopics.description: Use task for async work tied to view identity, task(id:) for key-driven restart, and refreshable for user-initiated refresh. Cancellation follows disappearance or identity change.

callouts.title: Avoid Starting Work in body
callouts.text: body may run often. Use task, onChange, commands, or model methods with clear lifetime ownership.

subtopics.title: Animation, Gestures & Accessibility
subtopics.description: Animate explicit state changes, respect reduced motion, prefer semantic controls, combine elements deliberately, and supply labels/values/hints where visible content is insufficient.

subtopics.title: Feature Models, UIKit Interop & Testing
subtopics.description: Keep domain and I/O outside views, isolate feature state in observable models, wrap UIKit/AppKit with representables, and test semantics plus state transitions.

subtopics.title: Performance & Production Checklist
subtopics.description: Profile invalidations, layout, images, scrolling, and main-actor work; keep list rows lightweight and load resources asynchronously.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Use stable identity, one source of truth, cancellable tasks, typed navigation, adaptive layout, semantic controls, reduced-motion support, preview/test dependencies, and Instruments on release builds.
